errors.text_span: Performance consistently improves with both larger model scale and broader SFT dataset: for example, LLaMA-2-7B scores ~67% with no SFT and ~83% with full SFT (D₀–D₂); LLaMA-2-13B improves from ~70% to ~80%; and LLaMA-2-70B rises from ~80% to ~83%. The chart visually supports the claim that scaling both model size and SFT dataset leads to better performance on longer math word problems, as reflected in higher CoLeG-R scores.
errors.evidence: The description includes interpretation and inference beyond what is explicitly shown in the figure, such as claims about performance improvement trends and implications for math word problems.
